summary.intent: Consolidate multiple separate feature branches (design, elevation, Near Me, route generation, multi-neighborhood filtering) into the deployed sf-stairs-map app.
summary.outcome: Created a release branch `sf-stairs/release-all` merging main's design/elevation/Near Me work with the route-generator branch's route planning and multi-neighborhood filtering; build passes but browser tests were inconclusive and main/production were left untouched pending user confirmation to merge and deploy.

repo: main already contained design, elevation, and Near Me trail features — only the route-generator branch was unmerged
The route-generator branch conflicted with newer production files (main), requiring manual conflict resolution favoring the newer production features
src/main.ts and src/multi-neighborhood.css were the files touched when integrating route planning/multi-neighborhood filtering into the consolidated branch
workflow: Check for and kill/reset stale local dev servers (e.g. Vite) before relying on Playwright/browser test suites, since stale served code can cause the suite to hang or fail to complete
When consolidating multiple long-lived feature branches, merge into a separate release branch first rather than main, so nothing is deployed until explicitly confirmed

friction: Playwright browser test suite could not finish because an existing local Vite server was serving stale code, blocking full verification of the merge
Merging the route-generator branch required manual conflict resolution against newer production features (elevation, Near Me)
open_items: Restart/clear the stale Vite dev server and re-run the full Playwright browser suite to verify the consolidated release branch
Get user confirmation before merging `sf-stairs/release-all` into main and deploying to production
